ember_left:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production background artwork for Shadows of Fate, a dark Norse fantasy 2D side-scrolling action RPG. Generate LEFT HALF of a very wide underground Ember Mine environment. Output 2816 x 1408 pixels, landscape 2:1, high-resolution crisp detailed painted game environment. Reference 1 is visual style ONLY: Nidavellir black carved basalt, worn iron, bronze knotwork and amber furnace light. Reference 2 is style AND camera: Iron Road front-facing side-scroller continuous horizontal walkway with a visible thick foundation, no perspective along travel direction. 
Scene: beneath the dwarf city Svartalfheim, abandoned but still smoldering ore excavation galleries supplying ancient god-forges. Left quarter contains a recessed dwarf masonry service tunnel and heavy timber/iron shoring, warm distant city-lantern glow. Center has stepped background excavation faces with sparse glowing orange ember ore, an overhead iron winch and chain, an old ore cart parked well BEHIND the walking lane. Farther right open layered basalt cave with subdued mist and small glowing ore seams, dwarven chiseled stone reinforcement and ancient tools. Rich convincing geology, tiny embers, restrained cinematic haze. Ground/props sharp at playable plane, distant cave softer. No giant lava lake, no sky, no people, no monsters, no icons, no text, no painted portals.
CRITICAL GAME GEOMETRY: camera level, side elevation, panorama crops naturally on both sides. A single uninterrupted PERFECTLY HORIZONTAL stone/compacted coal walkway spans the entire width. The top walking surface is the narrow band y=1000..1106 (71%..78.57% of height); the FRONT HORIZONTAL LIP of this walkway is EXACTLY y=1106, with 302 pixels of dark solid foundation visible below, all the way to bottom. All obstructions, carts, rails, pillars and ore deposits stay BEHIND the lane or above y=980. Absolutely no pits, ramps, stairs, foreground pillars crossing the lane or major props in the lane. The player will stand on the front lip.
Seam design: final rightmost 440px must be subdued continuous natural rough dark basalt with no prominent structure, open clear walking surface, uninterrupted front lip and foundation. This area will overlap the next image: keep it consistent and easy to join. Do not fade to black at edges. Full bleed artwork. Match existing references' rich semi-realistic hand-painted detail, deep charcoal, subtle bronze and restrained warm orange accents, readable moderate-dark lighting (not crushed blacks).

Make new coherent architecture without repeating the prominent cart/tunnel/winch composition of reference.
hall_left:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game environment for Shadows of Fate. Create LEFT HALF of the Hall of Silence, a vast abandoned ancestral dwarven foundry under Svartalfheim. Output 2560 x 1408 pixels, very detailed crisp painterly semi-realistic dark Norse fantasy 2D side-scrolling RPG background. Reference images are STYLE and horizontal game-camera guides only; build an interior, not another town or outside road.
Massive black basalt square pillars with restrained old bronze knotwork, immense shadowed vaulted ceiling, distant rows of obsolete forges, cold iron flues, rusted overhead chains and a hoist, ancient anvils and a tidy rack of inherited hammers and tongs behind the playable lane. A stone relief of anonymous dwarven smiths on a back wall, with a small deliberately CHISELED-AWAY name panel: visual evidence of erased history, no legible text. Sparse cold pale blue rune inlays on supporting architecture, subtle shafts of dusty blue light from ceiling cracks, traces of former ember light only in very far-left tunnel that connects back to the Ember Mine. This was the largest forge beneath the mountain; now it has been unnaturally silenced. Convey absence, abandoned craft and mystery. Do not reveal villains or add living people, ghosts, monsters, statues of named gods, readable inscriptions, UI or portal VFX.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY: strict front-facing side-scroller elevation, no vanishing-point corridor receding toward viewer. A continuous horizontal narrow dark stone walkway from left edge to right edge. Walkable surface occupies y=1000..1106. Its straight FRONT LIP is EXACTLY y=1106 (78.57% height); below it are 302 pixels of solid dark carved foundation down to bottom. Keep every pillar and prop BEHIND the walkable surface, no front pillars, no pits, no stairs, no ramps, no huge debris crossing the lane. Clear unobstructed combat silhouettes.
The last rightmost 340 pixels should be a subdued shadowed basalt wall bay with low-contrast smoke and no distinctive pillar, doorway or item; continuous horizontal floor and foundation, no edge vignette. It will overlap the next half seamlessly. Light level and material detail match the supplied existing game art, charcoal and desaturated steel-blue with faint bronze accents. Full bleed artwork with no frame.
hall_right:
Create the RIGHT HALF continuation of the supplied Hall of Silence panorama for Shadows of Fate. This reference is the left half; generate a NEW continuation with identical camera height, stone/metal scale, detailed painterly finish and cold steel-blue lighting. Landscape ratio 2560:1408. Strict front-facing side-scrolling game environment.
At the left edge continue the quiet dim basalt wall and pale drifting dust from reference right edge, without repeating the large smith relief. A huge dark abandoned furnace with cold mouth and heavy rusted chains in background left-middle, a broken stationary bellows with wooden ribs, huge old black iron ducts ascending into vaulted darkness, dwarven square basalt pillars with bronze geometric knotwork, faint icy blue inlaid rune traces. Keep consistent subtle amber pinlights in foundation. Right third contains an imposing ancient sealed forge door flanked by weathered rune-bearing pillars and a worn circular abstract geometric rune seal in the BACK WALL above a low anvil dais, visual focal point behind the future Rune Watcher arena; no boss painted in. Some carved ancestral name panels have been chiseled smooth; no readable text, and no premature reveal of Thor or Loki. The extreme right edge has open level passage past the door area, leading deeper to Cold Forge.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY: EXACTLY match reference floor front-lip height (about 74% of image), uninterrupted full-width perfectly HORIZONTAL stone walkway, same paving and thick foundation. No staircase, no ramps, no foreground obstacles, no holes, no raised floor. All huge architecture BEHIND the playable lane. Keep leftmost 340px subdued and suitable for joining to reference right edge; same horizontal floor lines, no edge vignette. No characters, creatures, ghosts, HUD, painted portal VFX, letters or watermarks. Rich charcoal shadows with enough blue fill to read all surface detail.
detail: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a precisely registered TILE of an existing production game panorama, NOT an independent composition. Restore high-frequency detail to this slightly enlarged image. Preserve the exact scene, all object silhouettes, architectural positions, crop, proportions, palette, exposure, lighting, and every edge position. Do not zoom, pan, reframe, rearrange, add objects or change camera. Retain the input aspect ratio exactly. The horizontal front lip of the stone floor MUST remain at 78.57 percent of height, exactly the same position as the input, with an unobstructed walking surface above it. Do not lift or lower it. The outer 15 percent on both left and right MUST closely match input geometry for seamless joining with neighboring tiles. Sharpen by naturally redrawing small stone pores, cracks, iron rivets, carved bronze details and paving texture, not by adding sharpening halos or grain. Keep natural semi-realistic dark fantasy painterly game art. Clean up any ghosted/doubled masonry inside the image without changing the overall structure. No new text, symbols, characters, monsters, HUD, border, watermark. Output just the faithfully enhanced image at maximum resolution.
